summary: This Form 6-K filed by Alamos Gold Inc. reports the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on May 28, 2026. It discloses voting outcomes on the election of 11 director nominees, the re-appointment of KPMG LLP as auditor, and a non-binding advisory resolution on executive compensation. The filing is a routine post-meeting disclosure of shareholder votes under Canadian continuous disclosure obligations. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or management change is present. The registrant simply fulfills its reporting requirement as a foreign private issuer via Form 6-K, which maps to the US equivalent of a Form 8-K item for shareholder meeting results.
